title: How to Test Product Photo Background Colors Beyond Pure White
description: Compare white, neutral, and branded product-photo backgrounds with a controlled test instead of assuming one color always performs best.

blocks.text: "Just use white backgrounds" is standard e-commerce advice. It's not wrong—but it's incomplete.
For non-Amazon platforms (Shopify, Etsy, social media), white is often the worst choice. Here's what actually converts.

The Consistency Rule
You can use different backgrounds for different platforms—but within a single platform, always use the same background style.

items.text: Instagram: All lifestyle or brand color

blocks.text: Cross-platform variation is fine. Within-platform variation is chaos.
The Testing Approach
Not sure what background converts best for your niche? A/B test.
Run each for 2-4 weeks. Measure conversion, CTR, and time-on-listing.
Sometimes results surprise you. Beauty products often convert 15-25% better on soft cream than pure white. Fitness products often convert better on dark backgrounds.
The Data Insight
Sellers who test backgrounds routinely find their conversion sweet spot is often not pure white. But they'd never know if they hadn't tested.
Master files at edit-photo.com let you test easily. Same product, three background variations, three different listings.
